description: This file contains initialization code for the Atmel SAM4L MCU series, including clock setup, watchdog timer configuration, and oscillator management, specific to the Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: wdt_set_ctrl
methods.description: Sets the WatchDog Timer Control register with the provided control value, using specific write keys.

methods.name: pll_is_locked
methods.description: Checks if the specified PLL is locked.

methods.name: osc_is_ready
methods.description: Checks if a specified oscillator is ready based on its ID.

methods.name: pll_config_init
methods.description: Configures PLL parameters based on divide and multiply factors, returning the register value.

methods.name: flashcalw_set_wait_state
methods.description: Sets the flash wait state depending on the CPU frequency.

methods.name: flashcalw_is_ready
methods.description: Checks if flash calibration is ready.

methods.name: flashcalw_issue_command
methods.description: Issues a command to the flash controller for a specific page.

methods.name: clock_init
methods.description: Initializes system clocks, including PLL setup and clock dividers.

methods.name: z_arm_platform_init
methods.description: Main initialization function called at platform startup, disables watchdog if configured and sets up clocks.
